summary: APPlife Digital Solutions filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with 104, LLC and issuance of a $60,000 principal convertible promissory note for a $54,000 purchase price, including a $6,000 original issue discount; the investor funded October 26, 2026 and the deal closed that date. Net proceeds of $46,720 follow $3,500 legal fees and $3,780 to Craft Capital Management. The note carries a 12% one-time interest charge ($7,200), matures October 22, 2027, is unsecured, and converts at 65% of the lowest traded price over the prior 20 trading days, subject to a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership cap and volume-based step-down to 50%. This is a routine convertible-note financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and share-reserve mechanics.
